story_options.title: Nature-strip gardens are a paradise for pollinators in your street
story_options.reason: An uplifting, practical nature story with colorful visual potential and a message that small everyday actions can help wildlife.
story_options.title_en: Street-Side Nature Gardens Offer Pollinators a Tiny Paradise
story_options.reason_en: This uplifting nature story shows how small, everyday gardening choices can help wildlife and bring colorful possibilities to an ordinary street.
story_options.en_copy: A small patch of greenery beside a street can become a welcoming place for pollinators. Nature-strip gardens offer a cheerful reminder that everyday actions can help wildlife—and that a little planting can add a lot of life to a neighborhood.
story_options.duck_en: A little garden can make a big splash in the neighborhood.
story_options.x_en: A patch of street-side greenery can become a tiny paradise for pollinators. A cheerful reminder that small everyday actions can help wildlife. 🌼🦆
story_options.title_ja: 街の小さな自然 garden が花粉を運ぶ生き物の楽園に
story_options.reason_ja: 身近なガーデニングの小さな工夫が野生生物を助け、いつもの通りに彩りを添えられることを伝える、前向きな自然の話題です。
story_options.jp_copy: 通り沿いの小さな緑地が、花粉を運ぶ生き物たちを迎える場所になることがあります。自然を取り入れた街路脇の庭は、日々のちょっとした行動が野生生物を助け、地域にたくさんの命をもたらせることを教えてくれます。
story_options.duck_jp: 小さな庭でも、街では大きな存在感を出せるよ。
story_options.x_jp: 通り沿いの小さな緑地が、花粉を運ぶ生き物たちの小さな楽園に。身近な行動が野生生物を助けられるという、明るいニュースです。🌼🦆

story_options.title: Too many males to choose from can overwhelm female frogs—and change who gets to mate
story_options.reason: The funny comparison between frog courtship and overloaded dating apps gives this animal story instant humor and memorability.
story_options.title_en: Too Many Suitors Can Overwhelm Female Frogs
story_options.reason_en: The surprising frog courtship story is memorable and amusing, showing that having too many potential mates can change who gets to mate.
story_options.en_copy: For female frogs, an abundance of males is not always a simple choice. Too many suitors can become overwhelming—and can change who gets to mate. It is a playful reminder that even in the frog world, more options do not always make things easier.
story_options.duck_en: Sometimes the pond has more suitors than a frog can handle.
story_options.x_en: Too many male frogs can overwhelm females—and change who gets to mate. A surprising reminder that even frog courtship has its complications. 🐸🦆
story_options.title_ja: オスが多すぎると、メスのカエルは困ってしまう
story_options.reason_ja: 求愛相手が多すぎると、メスのカエルが圧倒され、誰が繁殖相手になるかまで変わるという、意外で記憶に残る動物の話です。
story_options.jp_copy: メスのカエルにとって、オスが多ければ多いほど選びやすいとは限りません。求愛するオスが多すぎると負担になり、誰が繁殖相手になるかも変わることがあります。カエルの世界でも、選択肢が多ければいつも楽になるとは限らないようです。
story_options.duck_jp: 池に相手が多すぎると、カエルも選ぶのが大変だね。
story_options.x_jp: オスのカエルが多すぎると、メスは圧倒され、誰が繁殖相手になるかも変わることがあるそうです。カエルの求愛にも、いろいろな難しさがあります。🐸🦆

story_options.title: Taste shapes support for climate-friendly school meals
story_options.reason: Food is universally relatable, and the practical finding that taste and familiarity matter makes a climate story approachable rather than technical.
story_options.title_en: Taste Helps Shape Support for Climate-Friendly School Meals
story_options.reason_en: This approachable food story highlights a practical point: taste and familiarity matter when people consider climate-friendly school meals.
story_options.en_copy: Climate-friendly school meals may win more support when they taste good and feel familiar. The finding makes a broad climate conversation wonderfully practical: what is on the plate matters, and so does how it tastes.
story_options.duck_en: A climate-friendly meal still has to make taste buds happy.
story_options.x_en: Taste and familiarity matter when people consider climate-friendly school meals. A practical reminder that good food can help make big ideas feel approachable. 🍽️🦆
story_options.title_ja: 気に入った味が、環境に配慮した学校給食への支持を左右する
story_options.reason_ja: 環境に配慮した学校給食を考えるとき、味や親しみやすさが大切だと示す、身近で実践的な食の話題です。
story_options.jp_copy: 環境に配慮した学校給食は、おいしくて親しみやすいものであれば、より支持を得られるかもしれません。この話題は、気候をめぐる大きな議論を身近なものにしてくれます。皿の上身の内容だけでなく、味も大切なのです。
story_options.duck_jp: 環境にやさしい給食も、まずは舌をよろこばせなくちゃね。
story_options.x_jp: 環境に配慮した学校給食では、味と親しみやすさが大切。おいしい食事が、大きなテーマを身近にしてくれるという実践的な話題です。🍽️🦆

story_options.title: Devil’s Arrows: Ancient builders hauled 55,000-pound stones 11 miles for Britain’s tallest stone row
story_options.reason: A dramatic human achievement from prehistory creates a strong sense of wonder and invites readers to imagine how ancient communities accomplished the impossible.
story_options.title_en: Ancient Builders Hauled 55,000-Pound Stones 11 Miles for Britain’s Tallest Stone Row
story_options.reason_en: This astonishing prehistoric achievement sparks wonder by showing the scale of what ancient communities accomplished together.
story_options.en_copy: Ancient builders moved 55,000-pound stones across 11 miles to create Britain’s tallest stone row. The feat invites us to imagine the determination and cooperation behind a monument that still inspires wonder.
story_options.duck_en: That is one seriously heavy lift for a very tall row of stones.
story_options.x_en: Ancient builders hauled 55,000-pound stones 11 miles for Britain’s tallest stone row. A remarkable feat that still makes us wonder how they did it. 🪨🦆
story_options.title_ja: 古代の人々、5万5000ポンドの石を11マイル運び英国一高い石列を築く
story_options.reason_ja: 古代の人々が力を合わせて成し遂げた途方もない規模の仕事に、驚きと想像力をかき立てられる話題です。
story_options.jp_copy: 古代の建設者たちは、5万5000ポンドの石を11マイル運び、英国で最も高い石列を築きました。その偉業を前にすると、今も残る記念物の背後にあった決意と協力に思いをはせずにはいられません。
story_options.duck_jp: これは、ものすごく高い石列のための、ものすごく重い荷運びだね。
story_options.x_jp: 古代の建設者たちは、5万5000ポンドの石を11マイル運び、英国一高い石列を築きました。どうやって成し遂げたのか、今も驚かされる偉業です。🪨🦆
